releaseNotes: AURA 3.9.9: frequency diagnostic cards now have a working APPLY EQ button - one click applies that card's gentle EQ move to the master AURA Assist EQ (turns Assist on; reversible with Flat), shown only on cards that carry an EQ move. The Apply Auto-Mix button now explains why it is unavailable (enable Continuous, building the average, or all stems on target) instead of just greying out. Apply Auto-Mix (level trims to your senders) and AURA Assist (master EQ) are separate, independent features. Fully close the DAW before installing.
